items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I was playing with they used to play with him in New Orleans you see he played with us with Oliver... Wages Williams wanted to open up the up the the this the Royal Garden and I sent for Joe for him off to play for him

ctx.x: did he play with you when he first came

no when he first came you see I was playing with they used to play with him in New Orleans you see he played with us with Oliver but when after I got up there Wages Williams wanted to open up the up the the this the Royal Garden and I sent for Joe for him off to play for him yeah I see then after Joe come up then we got together and got our rigged bunch together
were you there the night the first night Joe played sure what happened how did people like you
